summary: Slice A — Forum Chat Auto Relationship Context Resolution (FKR v1) VERIFIED at HTTP layer. 7/7 pytest scenarios PASS (100%) against POST /api/mirror/chat on the public preview URL. All scenarios return 200, all responses contain non-empty LLM text, and the explicit leakage check confirms NONE of the internal taxonomy tokens (PAIRWISE, MULTI_PERSON, AMBIGUOUS, scope_class, forum_intent, covenant_partner, steward_guardian) appear in any LLM-visible surface — they stay inside the receipt envelope as designed. Backend log evidence (grep '[MIRROR_CHAT][RFv2]' /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log) confirms the new resolver auto-detected every frame correctly: S1 'Tell me about Mel' (about_person_id=MEL) → frame=MEMBER role=spouse stance=covenant_partner src=forum_relationship_edges conf=0.95; S2 'What does Thaddeus need from me?' (NO about_person_id — Slice A name-only path) → frame=MEMBER role=child stance=steward_guardian src=forum_relationship_edges conf=0.95; S3 'Tell me about myself' → frame=SELF src=self_no_target conf=0.95; S4 'How are Mel and Thaddeus affecting each other?' → frame=PAIRWISE src=pairwise_pattern conf=0.8; S5 'What about my children right now?' → frame=MULTI_PERSON src=scope_class conf=0.85; S6 & S7 forum-whole variants → frame=FORUM src=forum_intent conf=0.55. Every request also logs '[MIRROR_CHAT][RFv2-prompt] block_emitted=False flag_enabled=False reason=flag_off' — prompt-surface remains correctly gated off, no Slice A prompt-side mutation reached the LLM. Slice 2 regression (explicit about_person_id) is intact: Mel still resolves as spouse / covenant_partner via forum_relationship_edges. /api/health 200. No crashes, no 5xx, no taxonomy leakage.
